# payload-fields — Agent usage

Configure a coding agent for @nexload-sdk/payload-fields.

**Topic:** agents
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-fields` v4.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-fields/agents/
## Install matching skills

Install the skills whose triggers match the task.

### payload-fields-core

[Trigger](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/skills/payload-fields/core/SKILL.md)

```text
Use when integrating or reviewing the overall @nexload-sdk/payload-fields factory architecture, including options-object compatibility, protected field names/types/components, safe overrides, hook composition, Payload Import Map subpaths, server versus Admin client boundaries, plugin registration decisions, major-version migration, or package-wide validation. Use a specialized sibling for one slug, Jalali, or money contract.
```

```bash
npx skills add gecut/nexload-sdk --skill payload-fields-core
```

### payload-fields-slug

[Trigger](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/skills/payload-fields/slug/SKILL.md)

```text
Use when adding, debugging, migrating, or reviewing @nexload-sdk/payload-fields managed slugs, including the slug/lock tuple and spread usage, Unicode/Persian normalization, lock and localization synchronization, nested source paths, regeneration on source changes, source clearing and manual edits, protected Admin wiring, or registered server-side generator authentication, access, input validation, and final normalization.
```

```bash
npx skills add gecut/nexload-sdk --skill payload-fields-slug
```

### payload-fields-jalali-date

[Trigger](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/skills/payload-fields/jalali-date/SKILL.md)

```text
Use when adding, migrating, debugging, or reviewing @nexload-sdk/payload-fields Jalali date behavior, including native ISO persistence, Persian presentation, display timezone boundaries, dayOnly/dayAndTime/timeOnly/monthOnly picker modes, canonical local noon, Jalali month normalization, null/clear behavior, virtual Jalali timestamps, Admin UI limitations, or date-focused tests.
```

```bash
npx skills add gecut/nexload-sdk --skill payload-fields-jalali-date
```

### payload-fields-money

[Trigger](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/skills/payload-fields/money/SKILL.md)

```text
Use when adding, migrating, debugging, or reviewing @nexload-sdk/payload-fields money behavior, including integer minor-unit persistence and APIs, explicit major-unit parsing, IRR/IRT or custom currency fraction digits, Persian/Arabic numeric input, safe integers and precision, negative policy, min/max bounds, display formatting, consumer validation order, Admin behavior, or money data migration.
```

```bash
npx skills add gecut/nexload-sdk --skill payload-fields-money
```

## Project AGENTS.md

```markdown
For @nexload-sdk/payload-fields, load payload-fields-core when its trigger matches. Read the package bundle and check public exports against the installed version before editing.
```

[Scoped Markdown bundle](/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-fields/llms.txt).

## Prompts

```text
Edit Jalali dates, slugs and prices in Payload Admin. Use @nexload-sdk/payload-fields and payload-fields-core. Inspect the installed version and show a minimal typed example for my project.
```

```text
Review my @nexload-sdk/payload-fields integration against the optimization page. Identify the relevant source for each finding and one test for the highest-risk behavior.
```

## Exported Factories Summary

| Function | Output | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `slugField(options)` | `[TextField, CheckboxField]` | Returns `[slug, slugLock]` fields with Unicode slugifier, collision suffixing (`-2`, `-3`), and sync logic. |
| `jalaliDateField(options)` | `DateField` | Returns a Payload `date` field configured with the Jalali solar calendar Admin component and timezone stability. |
| `jalaliDateRangeField(options)` | `RowField` | Returns a paired row containing `startsAt` and `endsAt` Jalali date fields with order validation. |
| `withJalaliTimestamps(fields, options)` | `Field[]` | Appends virtual read-only `createdAtJalali` and `updatedAtJalali` fields to an existing field array. |
| `moneyField(options)` | `NumberField` | Returns an integer `number` field configured with formatted currency Admin component and cell. |
| `iranMobileField(options)` | `TextField` | Returns a `text` field validating Iranian mobile numbers (`09XXXXXXXXX` or `+989...`). |
| `iranLandlineField(options)` | `TextField` | Returns a `text` field validating Iranian landlines with province area codes. |
| `nationalCodeField(options)` | `TextField` | Returns a `text` field with Iranian national code checksum validation. |
| `legalIdField(options)` | `TextField` | Returns a `text` field with Iranian legal entity ID checksum validation. |
| `postalCodeField(options)` | `TextField` | Returns a `text` field validating 10-digit Iranian postal codes. |
| `bankCardField(options)` | `TextField` | Returns a `text` field with 16-digit bank card Luhn checksum validation. |
| `shebaField(options)` | `TextField` | Returns a `text` field with Iranian IBAN (Sheba) ISO 7064 checksum validation. |
| `ltrTextField(options)` | `TextField` | Returns a `text` field with forced LTR direction and optional monospace styling. |
| `sortOrderField(options)` | `NumberField` | Returns an indexed non-negative integer `number` field in the sidebar for sorting. |
| `iranAddressField(options)` | `GroupField` | Returns a `group` field containing province (31 Iranian provinces), city, line, postal code, and optional recipient. |
| `payloadFieldsPlugin(options)` | `Plugin` | Registers server slug generator endpoints and `beforeOperation` string money normalization. |

***

## Schema Adapter (`@nexload-sdk/payload-fields/schema`)

`schemaFields` wraps field factories into `field.native(...)` definitions for `@nexload-sdk/payload-schema`:

| Method | Target Factory | Zod Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaFields.iranMobile(options)` | `iranMobileField` | `iranMobileSchema` from `@nexload-sdk/persian/zod` |
| `schemaFields.iranLandline(options)` | `iranLandlineField` | `iranLandlineSchema` from `@nexload-sdk/persian/zod` |
| `schemaFields.nationalCode(options)` | `nationalCodeField` | `nationalCodeSchema` from `@nexload-sdk/persian/zod` |
| `schemaFields.legalId(options)` | `legalIdField` | `legalIdSchema` from `@nexload-sdk/persian/zod` |
| `schemaFields.postalCode(options)` | `postalCodeField` | `postalCodeSchema` from `@nexload-sdk/persian/zod` |
| `schemaFields.bankCard(options)` | `bankCardField` | `cardNumberSchema` from `@nexload-sdk/persian/zod` |
| `schemaFields.sheba(options)` | `shebaField` | `shebaSchema` from `@nexload-sdk/persian/zod` |
| `schemaFields.ltrText(options)` | `ltrTextField` | `z.string()` with optional min/max lengths |
| `schemaFields.sortOrder(options)` | `sortOrderField` | `z.number().int().nonnegative()` |
| `schemaFields.money(options)` | `moneyField` | `z.number().int().safe()` (non-negative by default) |
| `schemaFields.jalaliDate(options)` | `jalaliDateField` | `z.iso.datetime({ offset: true })` |
| `schemaFields.slug(options)` | `slugField` | `{ slug: z.string(), slugLock: z.boolean() }` |

> Note: `iranAddressField` and `jalaliDateRangeField` are not included in `./schema` in 4.0.

## Compatibility Helpers

| Helper | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `formatSlug` | `(value: string) => string` | Canonical slugifier alias of `slugify` from `@nexload-sdk/persian/text`. |
| `formatJalaliDate` | `(value, options) => string \| null` | Formats an ISO datetime or Date into a Jalali string. |
| `toStoredJalaliInstant` | `(picked, appearance, timeZone?) => string` | Converts picked Jalali components to an ISO instant (noon for date-only modes). |
| `formatMoney` | `(value, currency, display?) => string \| null` | Formats integer minor units into currency strings. |
| `parseMoneyToMinorUnits` | `(input, currency) => number` | Parses string or major-unit text into safe integer minor units. |
| `IRR` | `MoneyCurrencyDefinition` | Iranian Rial currency definition. |
| `IRT` | `MoneyCurrencyDefinition` | Iranian Toman currency definition. |
| `resolveCurrency` | `(currency: MoneyCurrency) => MoneyCurrencyDefinition` | Resolves string or object currency to canonical definition. |

# Production Guides & Recipes

Deep recipes for managed Unicode slugs, Jalali date ranges, integer money fields, Iranian contact & identity, addresses, and schema integration.

**Topic:** guides
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-fields` v4.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-fields/guides/
## Managed Unicode Slugs

The `slugField` factory generates clean, URL-friendly slugs while preserving non-Latin scripts (such as Persian and Arabic):

```ts
import { slugField } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-fields";

const fields = [
  { name: "title", type: "text", required: true },
  ...slugField({
    source: "title",
    overrides: {
      slug: {
        admin: {
          position: "sidebar",
          description: "Auto-generated from title. Unlock to manually edit.",
        },
      },
    },
  }),
];
```

### Uniqueness & Collision Suffixing

* Slugs are unique by default (`unique: true`). When creating a document whose generated slug already exists, the factory automatically searches for non-colliding suffixes (`-2`, `-3`, up to `-50`).
* **Top-level only:** Uniqueness collision queries apply only to top-level fields. Slugs placed inside nested arrays or groups receive character normalization only.
* If migrating an existing database with duplicate slug values, resolve duplicates before creating unique indexes or pass `unique: false`.

### Slug Locking Mechanism

* When a document is created, `slugLock` defaults to `true`.
* Editing the source field updates `slug` while locked.
* Once locked documents are published, unlocking allows manual editing. While unlocked, source edits never change the slug. A locked slug follows source edits unless you pass `regenerateOnSourceChange: false`.

***

## Jalali (Persian Solar) Datepicker & Date Ranges

Store standard ISO datetimes while providing a rich Persian Solar calendar widget in Payload Admin:

```ts
import { jalaliDateField, jalaliDateRangeField, withJalaliTimestamps } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-fields";

const fields = [
  jalaliDateField({
    name: "eventDate",
    pickerAppearance: "dayAndTime", // Options: "dayOnly" | "dayAndTime" | "monthOnly" | "timeOnly"
    timeZone: "Asia/Tehran", // Default timezone
  }),
  jalaliDateRangeField({
    start: "registrationStart",
    end: "registrationEnd",
  }),
];

// Adds virtual read-only createdAtJalali and updatedAtJalali fields
export const collectionFields = withJalaliTimestamps(fields);
```

### Date Storage Guarantees

* The database always stores standard UTC ISO 8601 strings (e.g. `2026-07-24T08:30:00.000Z`).
* For `dayOnly` and `monthOnly`, dates store canonical noon (`12:00:00`) in `timeZone` (default `Asia/Tehran`). This prevents date shifts when users view or edit entries from different browser timezones.
* In `jalaliDateRangeField`, the end field includes server-side validation ensuring that the end date falls on or after the start date.

***

## Safe-Integer Money Fields

Prevent floating point inaccuracies by storing currency in integer minor units:

```ts
import { moneyField } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-fields";

const fields = [
  moneyField({
    name: "unitPrice",
    currency: "IRT", // Stored in Tomans
    minMinorUnits: 0,
    maxMinorUnits: 10_000_000_000,
  }),
  moneyField({
    name: "rialPrice",
    currency: "IRR", // Stored in Rials
    displayCurrency: "IRT", // Displayed as Tomans in Admin UI and list cell
  }),
];
```

### API Strings & Plugin Requirement

* In the Admin UI, users type numbers with Persian or Latin digits and thousands grouping.
* In REST, GraphQL, and Local API calls, values are stored as integers.
* **Critical Requirement:** `payloadFieldsPlugin()` is **REQUIRED** if money values are sent as strings through REST or Local API (e.g. `"۱۲۳٬۴۵۶"` or `"123456"`). Payload's core runs `parseFloat()` on number fields before field hooks run, which corrupts Persian digits. The plugin registers a `beforeOperation` hook that normalizes string values to safe integers before Payload processes them.

***

## Iranian Contact & Identity Fields

Standardize phone numbers, national identification, postal codes, and banking fields:

```ts
import {
  bankCardField,
  iranLandlineField,
  iranMobileField,
  legalIdField,
  nationalCodeField,
  postalCodeField,
  shebaField,
} from "@nexload-sdk/payload-fields";

const fields = [
  // Mobile: normalized to national 09XXXXXXXXX or E.164 +989XXXXXXXXX
  iranMobileField({ name: "mobile", storage: "national" }),
  // Landline: normalized with province area code
  iranLandlineField({ name: "phone" }),
  // National Code: 10 digits with checksum validation
  nationalCodeField({ name: "nationalCode" }),
  // Legal Entity ID: 11 digits with checksum validation
  legalIdField({ name: "companyId" }),
  // Postal Code: 10 digits
  postalCodeField({ name: "postalCode" }),
  // Bank Card: 16 digits with Luhn algorithm validation
  bankCardField({ name: "cardNumber" }),
  // Sheba (IBAN): 26 characters (IR...) with ISO 7064 validation
  shebaField({ name: "sheba" }),
];
```

### Validation & Localization

* Values written through any API are normalized server-side in `beforeValidate` (Persian digits converted, dashes/spaces removed).
* Validation errors are localized: admin sessions in `fa` (e.g. `fa-IR`) see Persian error messages; other languages see English error messages.
* Admin list views automatically display formatted strings via `FormattedCell` (e.g. `۰۹۱۲ ۳۴۵ ۶۷۸۹`, `۶۰۳۷-۹۹۱۲-۳۴۵۶-۷۸۹۰`).

***

## Iranian Address Group

Use `iranAddressField` to create a structured address group:

```ts
import { iranAddressField } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-fields";

const fields = [
  iranAddressField({
    name: "shippingAddress",
    required: true,
    recipient: true, // Includes recipientName and recipientMobile fields
  }),
];
```

* Province selection contains all 31 Iranian provinces with localized Persian and English labels.
* Includes city, address line (textarea), and validated postal code.

***

## Schema Adapter (`@nexload-sdk/payload-fields/schema`)

When using `@nexload-sdk/payload-schema` to share validation contracts with frontend forms or RPC endpoints:

```ts
import { defineEntity } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-schema";
import { schemaFields } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-fields/schema";

export const customerEntity = defineEntity({
  name: "Customer",
  fields: {
    mobile: schemaFields.iranMobile(),
    nationalCode: schemaFields.nationalCode(),
    price: schemaFields.money({ currency: "IRT" }),
    birthDate: schemaFields.jalaliDate({ nullable: true }),
    ...schemaFields.slug({ source: "title" }),
  },
});
```

> **Note:** `iranAddressField` and `jalaliDateRangeField` are not included in `./schema` in 4.0 because compound fields (groups and rows) require entity-level schema composition.

***

## Troubleshooting & Common Pitfalls

### 1. Custom Admin Controls Fallback to Plain Inputs

If Payload Admin displays plain number or text inputs instead of the Jalali datepicker or formatted money input:

* Regenerate Payload's Import Map by running:
  ```bash
  pnpm payload generate:importmap
  ```
* Ensure `@payloadcms/ui` and `payload` are `>=3.85.0 <4.0.0` and React is `^19.0.0`.

### 2. Money Strings Rejected by REST or Local API

If sending string values like `"150000"` or `"۱۵۰٬۰۰۰"` fails validation or gets parsed as `NaN`:

* Ensure `payloadFieldsPlugin()` is registered in your `payload.config.ts` plugins array.
* The plugin interceptively normalizes string money values in `beforeOperation` before Payload's core `parseFloat()` runs.

### 3. Duplicate Slug Migration Errors

If adding `slugField` to an existing collection throws a unique constraint database error:

* Deduplicate existing documents before deploying the schema change, or temporarily configure `slugField({ unique: false })`.

# Overview & Quick Start

Semantic Payload field factories for Unicode slugs, Jalali dates, integer money, Iranian contact & identity fields, and addresses.

**Topic:** overview
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-fields` v4.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-fields/
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-fields`

**Workspace version:** `4.0.0`

Production-grade semantic field factories and Admin integrations for Payload CMS.

[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nexload-sdk/payload-fields) · [Source](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/tree/main/packages/payload-fields)

`@nexload-sdk/payload-fields` provides production-hardened semantic field factories, Admin UI integrations, and validation for Payload CMS 3:

1. **Managed Unicode Slugs**: Collision-resistant (`-2`, `-3`), multi-lingual slug generation with an automatic lock toggle.
2. **Jalali Solar Dates & Ranges**: ISO datetime storage with interactive Persian Solar calendar datepickers and list cells (`Asia/Tehran` noon storage for date-only modes).
3. **Safe-Integer Money Fields**: Floating-point-free financial storage in integer minor units (Rials, Tomans) with formatted Admin UI inputs and currency conversion.
4. **Iranian Identity & Contact**: Checksum-validated national codes, legal IDs, postal codes, landlines, and mobile numbers (national or E.164 format).
5. **Banking & Utility Fields**: Bank card numbers with Luhn validation, Sheba IBANs, forced LTR inputs, and non-negative sort ordering.
6. **Iranian Address Group**: Comprehensive address group with 31 provinces, postal code normalization, and optional recipient details.
7. **Schema Adapter (`./schema`)**: Wrap fields as `field.native()` definitions for `@nexload-sdk/payload-schema`.

***

## 10-Second Code Snippet

```ts
import {
  iranAddressField,
  iranMobileField,
  jalaliDateField,
  jalaliDateRangeField,
  moneyField,
  nationalCodeField,
  slugField,
} from "@nexload-sdk/payload-fields";
import type { CollectionConfig } from "payload";

export const Customers: CollectionConfig = {
  slug: "customers",
  fields: [
    { name: "name", type: "text", required: true },
    // Spreads slug and slugLock fields
    ...slugField({ source: "name" }),
    // Persian solar calendar datepicker
    jalaliDateField({ name: "birthDate", pickerAppearance: "dayOnly" }),
    // Paired date range with start/end order validation
    jalaliDateRangeField({ start: "startsAt", end: "endsAt" }),
    // Stored as integer minor units (e.g. 150000)
    moneyField({ name: "credit", currency: "IRT", minMinorUnits: 0 }),
    // Normalized to national format (09123456789)
    iranMobileField({ name: "mobile", required: true }),
    // Validated 10-digit national code
    nationalCodeField({ name: "nationalCode" }),
    // Address group with province dropdown and postal code
    iranAddressField({ recipient: false }),
  ],
};
```

***

|---|---|---|

| **Payload CMS** | `>=3.85.0 <4.0.0` | Core headless CMS |
| **React / React-DOM** | `^19.0.1 \|\| ^19.1.2 \|\| ^19.2.1` | Matches Payload 3 Admin UI runtime |

***

## Storage & Contract Rules

### 1. Slugs & SlugLock

`slugField({ source: "title" })` returns an array of two Payload fields: `[slug, slugLock]`.

* Slugs are unique by default (`unique: true`). Top-level slug collisions automatically receive numeric suffixes (`-2`, `-3`) in the active locale.
* **Scope note:** Slug uniqueness collision resolution only applies to top-level slug fields. Slugs placed inside arrays or groups receive character formatting only.
* `slugLock` defaults to `true`. When locked, changing the source field will not mutate an existing slug, protecting indexed URLs.

### 2. Jalali Dates & Ranges

Dates are stored in the database as **standard ISO 8601 UTC strings** (e.g. `"2026-07-24T08:30:00.000Z"`).

* For `dayOnly` and `monthOnly` appearances, dates store canonical local noon (`12:00:00`) in `timeZone` (default `Asia/Tehran`), preventing date shifting across client timezones.
* `jalaliDateRangeField` groups two dates and validates that `endsAt >= startsAt`.

### 3. Money Values & Plugin Requirement

Money values are stored strictly as **integer minor units** (e.g. `100,000 Tomans` is stored as `100000`).

* **REST / Local API String Inputs:** `payloadFieldsPlugin()` is **REQUIRED** if money values are sent as strings (e.g. `"۱۲۳٬۴۵۶"` or `"123456"`). Payload core parses number-field strings with `parseFloat()` before field hooks run, corrupting Persian digits and thousands separators. The plugin's `beforeOperation` hook converts string values to safe integers before Payload parses them. Raw numbers work without the plugin.

### 4. Bilingual Validation Messages

Validation messages follow the active admin language (`req.i18n.language` or `useTranslation()`):

* Locales starting with `fa` (e.g. `fa`, `fa-IR`) receive Persian error messages.
* All other locales receive English error messages (v3 was always Persian).

### 5. Schema Adapter Scope

The `./schema` subpath exposes `schemaFields` for `@nexload-sdk/payload-schema`. In 4.0, `iranAddressField` and `jalaliDateRangeField` are not included in `./schema` (compound group/row schemas require entity-level composition).

***

## Quick Start: Adding Plugin for Slug Generators & String Money

Register `payloadFieldsPlugin` in your Payload config:

```ts
import { payloadFieldsPlugin, slugField } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-fields";
import { buildConfig } from "payload";

export default buildConfig({
  collections: [
    {
      slug: "products",
      fields: [
        { name: "title", type: "text", required: true },
        ...slugField({ source: "title", generator: "product" }),
      ],
    },
  ],
  plugins: [
    payloadFieldsPlugin({
      slugGenerators: {
        product: async ({ sourceValue }) => {
          return `sku-${sourceValue.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-")}`;
        },
      },
    }),
  ],
});
```

# payload-fields — Optimization

Production choices for @nexload-sdk/payload-fields.

**Topic:** optimization
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-fields` v4.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-fields/optimization/
## Normalize strings before field hooks

Install payloadFieldsPlugin() when REST or Local API callers send money values as strings. It normalizes Persian digits and separators before Payload parses number fields.

## Send integers from numeric clients

Pass minor-unit integers when the client already owns numeric conversion.

## Handle nested slug uniqueness

Automatic collision suffixes apply only to top-level slugs. For slugs inside arrays, groups, or named tabs, use `unique: false` to avoid relying on suffixing.

## Order field plugins deliberately

The plugin sees collections and globals present when it runs. Place plugins adding money fields before it, respecting its order of 900.

## Sources

[Package guidance](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/packages/payload-fields/README.md) · [Implementation](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/packages/payload-fields/src/index.ts). · [Matching skill](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/skills/payload-fields/core/SKILL.md).
